evolveitem.blackaugurite.description: A strange black stone that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.blackaugurite.letter.quest: Hey @!^I've been looking for something called Black Augurite. Apparently, the last place anyone saw it was somewhere around the Calico Desert.^If you happen to find one, could you bring it to me? I'd really like to get my hands on it. I've been wondering what it tastes like.^...I mean, what it's like.^Anyway, please hurry!^— Abigail
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.descripti: Abigail is looking for a Black Augurite from the Calico Desert. Apparently, she has a very particular interest in this stone.
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.objective: Find a black augurite for Abigail
evolveitem.blackaugurite.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much for bringing this to me. I won't forget that you went all the way to the Calico Desert to find it for me. I owe you one!
evolveitem.dragon.scale.description: A scale from a Dragon Pokémon that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.letter.quest: Hey @!^I've been looking for a Dragon Scale. Apparently some old reports say it was last seen near the sea. If you happen to find one, could you bring it to me? I'd really like to inspect it. Please hurry!^— Abigail
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.descriptio: Abigail is looking for a Dragon Scale. It seems to be tied to an unusual evolutionary change.
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.objective: Find a Dragon Scale for Abigail
evolveitem.dragon.scale.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much. This is exactly what I needed for my research.
evolveitem.dubious.disc.description: A transparent device of dubious origin that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.dubious.disc.letter.quest: Hey @!^I've heard reports of a mysterious Dubious Disc that may have been dropped in a strange place. If you discover one, please bring it to me. I want to study it!^— Abigail
evolveitem.dubious.disc.quest.descriptio: Abigail heard that a Dubious Disc was recently seen in the wild and wants to investigate it.
evolveitem.dubious.disc.quest.objective: Find a Dubious Disc for Abigail
evolveitem.dubious.disc.quest.response: You found it! Thank you. This may be the missing piece to the puzzle.
evolveitem.electirizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy.
evolveitem.electirizer.letter.quest: Hey @!^I've heard there are rumors of an Electirizer hidden somewhere in the wild. If you happen to find one, bring it by. I want to look at it closely.^— Abigail
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.description: Abigail is looking for an Electirizer after hearing about a strange surge in the area.
evolveitem.electirizer.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much. This should help with the research immensely.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.description: A cuff made from Galarica twigs that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.letter.quest: Hey @!^I heard someone found a Galarica Cuff in a remote area. If you come across one, could you bring it to me? I'm very curious about it.^— Abigail
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.descripti: Abigail wants to investigate a Galarica Cuff that was reportedly left behind in the wild.
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.objective: Find a Galarica Cuff for Abigail
evolveitem.galarica.cuff.quest.response: You found it! Thanks so much. This looks like the real thing.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.description: A wreath made from Galarica twigs that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.letter.quest: Hey @!^A traveler mentioned a Galarica Wreath hidden near the old trail. If you see one, I'd greatly appreciate it if you brought it my way.^— Abigail
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.descrip: Abigail is after a Galarica Wreath and suspects it may be hidden in the wilderness.
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.objecti: Find a Galarica Wreath for Abigail
evolveitem.galarica.wreath.quest.respons: You found it! Thank you. This is exactly the kind of clue I was hoping for.
evolveitem.kings.rock.description: A royal-looking stone that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.kings.rock.letter.quest: Hey @!^A King's Rock was reportedly found along the shore. If you happen to come across one, would you bring it to me? I want to confirm the story.^— Abigail
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.description: Abigail heard that a King's Rock was found on the coast and wants to examine it.
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.objective: Find a King's Rock for Abigail
evolveitem.kings.rock.quest.response: You found it! This is fantastic. Thank you for bringing it all the way here.
evolveitem.magmarizer.description: A box packed with energy that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.magmarizer.letter.quest: Hey @!^I heard there was a Magmarizer somewhere out in the wild. If you find one, please bring it over and I'll take a look.^— Abigail
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.description: Abigail is looking for a Magmarizer and believes it might be hidden near a volcanic area.
evolveitem.magmarizer.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much. This is exactly what I needed.
evolveitem.mail: Gunther has found an evolution item for you to investigate. The attached special order has started automatically.
evolveitem.mail.title: An Evolution Item Investigation
evolveitem.metal.coat.description: A special metallic coating that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.metal.coat.letter.quest: Hey @!^I need a Metal Coat for an experiment. If you happen across one in the wild, could you bring it to me? I'd be very grateful.^— Abigail
evolveitem.metal.coat.quest.description: Abigail wants a Metal Coat for her collection and is asking for help finding one.
evolveitem.metal.coat.quest.objective: Find a Metal Coat for Abigail
evolveitem.metal.coat.quest.response: You found it! This is perfect. Thank you for your help.
evolveitem.oval.stone.description: A peculiar oval stone that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.oval.stone.letter.quest: Hey @!^I heard someone found an Oval Stone in a remote field. If you uncover one, would you bring it to me? I want to test it.^— Abigail
evolveitem.oval.stone.quest.description: Abigail is looking for an Oval Stone after hearing about an unusual find in the area.
evolveitem.oval.stone.quest.objective: Find an Oval Stone for Abigail
evolveitem.oval.stone.quest.response: You found it! Thanks so much. This is an unusual and valuable piece.
evolveitem.power: This item allows you to trigger the evolution for {pokemon}
evolveitem.protector.description: A protective item that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.protector.letter.quest: Hey @!^A Protector was reportedly left behind near the mountains. If you find one, could you bring it to me? I'd be very interested in examining it.^— Abigail
evolveitem.protector.quest.description: Abigail is looking for a Protector, which was rumored to have been left somewhere remote.
evolveitem.protector.quest.response: You found it! Thank you. This is exactly the kind of rare item I was hoping for.
evolveitem.specialorder.donate: Deliver the evolution item in the drop box at the museum counter.
evolveitem.specialorder.text: Recent reports suggest that an evolution item may be hidden among the museum's finds. If you happen to uncover one, please bring it to me. I'd very much like to examine it.
evolveitem.up.grade.description: A mysterious device that can trigger a special evolution.
evolveitem.up.grade.letter.quest: Hey @!^I heard of an Up-Grade hidden somewhere in the wild. If you come across one, bring it here. I really want to inspect it.^— Abigail
evolveitem.up.grade.quest.description: Abigail is searching for an Up-Grade after hearing rumors of a strange device in the area.
evolveitem.up.grade.quest.response: You found it! Thank you so much. This is an incredible find.

stone.dawn.description: It gives off a faint, gentle glow that seems almost like morning light.
stone.dawn.feeling: A gentle energy stirs within you.
stone.dusk.description: It seems to absorb the light around it, casting an oddly dark shadow.
stone.dusk.feeling: A strange stillness settles over you.
stone.event.gunther.intro: Oh, good morning ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @! I hope it's not too early... Well, I just wanted to stop by and thank you in person for lending me your evolution stone. I had a call with {professor} to identify the stone. It seems to be a {power} and can be used to evolve {pokemons}. Isn't that amazing?! Well, I should let you get back to your work...
stone.event.gunther.message: You got the '{stone}'! It's been added to your wallet. {feeling} You've got a deeper understanding of your Pokémon.
stone.event.gunther.return: Oh! I almost forgot! Here is your {power} back.
stone.fire.description: It radiates an unusual warmth, even when surrounded by cold.
stone.fire.feeling: A gentle warmth spreads through your body.
stone.fire.pokemons: Vulpix, Growlithe, Eevee, Pansear and Capsakid.
stone.ice.description: It radiates an unnatural cold, yet never seems to melt or frost over.
stone.ice.feeling: A sudden chill runs through your body.
stone.ice.pokemons: Alolan Sandshrew, Alolan Vulpix, Eevee, Galarian Duramaka, Crabrawler and Cetoddle.
stone.item.description: {{extra}} Maybe Gunther can tell you more.
stone.leaf.description: It carries a faint scent of fresh leaves, despite having no trace of plant matter.
stone.leaf.feeling: You feel a sense of vitality spreading through your body.
stone.leaf.pokemons: Gloom, Weepinbell, Exeggcute, Hisuian Voltorb, Eevee, Nuzleaf and Pansage.
stone.moon.description: It seems to shimmer faintly in the dark.
stone.moon.feeling: A strange calm settles over you.
stone.moon.pokemons: Nidorina, Nidorino, Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Skitty and Munna.
stone.power.description: Allows you to trigger the evolutions of {{pokemons}}
stone.shiny.description: It catches the light in an unusual way, sparkling even when there is little light to reflect.
stone.shiny.feeling: You feel a strange clarity come over you.
stone.specialorder.donate: Deliver the evolution stone in the drop box at the museum counter.
stone.specialorder.text: Recent reports suggest that an evolution stone may be hidden among the geodes. If you happen to uncover one, please bring it to me. I'd very much like to examine it.
stone.sun.description: It feels strangely warm and seems to hold a faint inner glow.
stone.sun.feeling: A warm energy fills your body.
stone.sun.pokemons: Gloom, Sunkern, Cottonee, Petilil and Helioptile.
stone.thunder.description: It emits an unusual electrical charge.
stone.thunder.feeling: You feel an electrical charge through your body.
stone.thunder.pokemons: Pikachu, Magneton, Eevee, Nosepass, Eelektric, Charjabug and Tadbulb.
stone.water.description: Its surface is strangely cool and damp, as though it has just been pulled from deep water.
stone.water.feeling: You feel a cool sensation wash over you.
stone.water.pokemons: Poliwhirl, Shellder, Staryu, Eevee, Lombre and Panpour.
